findings.subject: Historical scoped incarnation
findings.detail: Dropping equality of original/current scoped incarnation is consistent with canonical C17 physical continuity. Context.resolve refuses historical results without proveContinuity. Procurement decision-host rereads archived evidence, resolves current actor scope, reauthenticates current roles and roleMap/canWrite, checks isCurrent, requires exactly one original and one current live scope pointing to the archive physicalIncarnation, and the same living physical record. Fresh resolution still requires byte-equal currentRef. Tombstone/recreate cannot satisfy the canonical physical identity comparison. This is source-level reasoning, not a runtime pass.

findings.subject: C20 / Memory40 / CurrentChoice46 composition
findings.detail: The 3 reviewed hunks add external selectors and attached-only readers without replacing existing request/binding pinning, source fences, duplicate-proof closure/finally close, stored-case double reads, participant checks or recordedPlanner recursion sentinel. Canonical C17 and C20 files above are absent from owned7 and mixed9. Historical originals remain attached to each recorded result; newer top-level evidence is not substituted into it.

It does not exercise actual C17 historical archive/physical continuity or recordedPlanner historical fallback, tombstone/recreate or mid-read revocation. findings.detail: procurement=attached now reopens only decision-attached refs with originalAmount, budget64, exact source reads before/after projection, matching currency/horizon, final authority and source-fence checks.
